introHtml: Pelican is synonymous with rugged durability, making these waterproof containers a top pick for safety managers and outdoor event planners. Unlike generic waterproof cases, Pelican containers feature crushproof, dustproof, and watertight construction that protects sensitive gear in extreme conditions. Whether you need custom-branded cases for field crews or promotional tumblers for a trade show, Pelican offers a range of styles from heavy-duty storage boxes to double-wall stainless steel drinkware. Decorate with your logo via pad printing or laser engraving for a lasting impression.
